account.displayNameHint: This is how others see you.
account.usernameHint: You sign in with it. You can change it later in your profile.
account.usernameRules: 2 to 64 characters: a to z, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore.
account.emailHint: Optional. You can also sign in with it and reset a forgotten password.
account.wrong: Username, email or password is wrong.
account.setupCodeHint: It is in the server's log (docker logs {{app}}), or set {{setupTokenEnv}}.
account.forgotSent: If there is an account with an address for this, a link is on its way.
account.forgotNoMail: The operator can make you a link under Accounts to set a new password.
account.emailTaken: This address belongs to another account already.
account.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
account.confirmFresh: Confirm with a fresh sign-in at your provider.
account.formerUsername: The old username stays reserved for you. You sign in with the new one only.
account.emailConfirmSent: A link to confirm is on its way to {{email}}. Until then your current address counts.
account.emailDuplicate: Another account has this address too. It does not count for signing in.
account.resetLinkSent: The link is on its way to {{email}}.
account.resetLinkShown: Pass this link on. It works only once.
account.resetByOperator: The operator made you a link for a new password.
account.secondFactorHint: When you sign in, {{app}} also asks for a code from your authenticator app or for a passkey.
account.totpScan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app and enter the code it shows.
account.totpKey: Or enter this key by hand:
account.totpOn: The authenticator app is set up.
account.codeHint: 6 digits from the authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
account.recoveryCodesHint: Each code works once, for when your phone is not at hand. Keep them safe: they are shown only now.
account.factorRequired: Every account on this server needs a second factor. Set it up now.
account.factorRequiredSwitch: Require a second factor of everybody
account.factorRequiredSwitchHint: On: every account without a second factor sets one up at its next sign-in. A passkey counts.
account.secondFactorOffHint: {{secondFactorOffEnv}} is set: nobody is asked for a second factor. Remove the variable and restart {{app}} once you can get in again.
account.factorResetHint: Removes this account's authenticator app and recovery codes and signs it out everywhere.
account.factorResetDevices: Disconnect the paired devices too (a lost phone stays signed in otherwise)
account.passkeysHint: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or the device's PIN, without a password.
account.signOutEverywhereHint: Signs out every other browser and paired device. Calendar programs, API keys and passkeys stay.
account.newSignInMail: Mail me about a new sign-in
account.newSignInMailHint: When somebody signs in from a browser {{app}} does not know yet.
account.pictureHint: Every signed-in account on this server sees it.
account.sessionExpiredHint: Sign in again. What you wrote on this page is kept.
account.setupSubtitle: The first account belongs to the operator: with it you invite others and manage {{app}}.

error.setup_code_wrong: The setup code is wrong. It is in the server's log.
error.display_name_taken: Someone shows this display name already.
error.email_invalid: This is not an email address.
error.password_too_short: The password needs at least {{minimum}} characters.
error.fresh_sign_in_needed: Sign in at your provider again for this.
error.account_blocked: This account is blocked. Ask the operator.
error.not_allowed: Only the operator may do this.
error.use_account_page: Change your own password in your profile.
error.password_login_off: Signing in with a password is off. This account signs in through a provider.
error.invite_invalid: This invitation has been used already or is not valid any more.
error.reset_invalid: This link has been used already or is not valid any more.
error.email_link_invalid: This link has been used already or is not valid any more.
error.no_pending_email: No address waits for its link.
error.enrolment_expired: That took too long. Start again.
error.sign_in_expired: That took too long. Sign in again.
error.factor_missing: Set up a second factor first.
error.factor_required: A second factor is required here. Set up another one first.
error.passkeys_off: Passkeys are turned off on this server.
error.passkey_invalid: This passkey did not sign you in.
error.passkey_expired: That took too long. Try again.
error.too_many_passkeys: No more passkeys fit. Remove one first.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
error.avatar_not_a_picture: This is not a picture we can read.
error.avatars_busy: Too many pictures at once. Try again in a moment.
error.public_url_needed: The link needs the public address of {{app}}. Enter it in the server settings.
error.unknown: That did not work. Try again.
